# What ShellCheck reads in place of the hosted runner's /etc/os-release.
#
# inspect-before.sh sources /etc/os-release, which exists on the Ubuntu runner
# it is written for and not on macOS. ShellCheck follows sourced files, so on a
# host without that file it reported "Not following" (SC1091) and the lint of a
# tracked script depended on the machine running it. The script's
# `# shellcheck source=` hint names this file instead, so every host checks the
# same thing.
#
# Nothing executes this. It declares only the two fields inspect-before.sh
# reads, in the form the runner's file gives them; the values are the ones
# that script requires.
ID=ubuntu
VERSION_ID="26.04"
